_meta.description: Federal Government Basic Pay Scales (BPS 1-22), base scales per Revision of Basic Pay Scales 2022 (Finance Division O.M. F.1(2)Imp/2022-283, 01-07-2022). Still the operative base scales: Budget 2024-25 granted Adhoc Relief Allowance-2024 (25% BPS 1-16, 20-22% BPS 17-22) and Budget 2025-26 granted ARA-2025 (10%) on top of these scales rather than revising them.
_meta.source: Finance Division (Regulations Wing) O.M. No.F.1(5)-Reg.7/87-317 dated 31-08-2022 (https://www.finance.gov.pk/circulars/circular_31082022.pdf, GP Fund memo reproducing BPS-2022 min/max per scale); cross-checked against https://civil-engineerings.com/pay_scale.php (BPS chart 2025-2026); ARA-2024 per https://www.finance.gov.pk/circulars/circular_10072024_1.pdf

allowances.house_rent_note: HRA paid at 45% (big cities) / 30% (other stations) of the initial (minimum) of the relevant Basic Pay Scale 2008, per long-standing Finance Division practice
allowances.medical_allowance_note: Fixed monthly medical allowance for BPS 1-16 (Rs 1,500/month under successive budgets); BPS 17-22 receive 15% of basic pay (frozen at 2011 levels per Finance Division circulars). Verify current-year circular before payroll use.
allowances.conveyance_allowance_note: Fixed monthly conveyance allowance by BPS band (approx. Rs 1,785 BPS 1-4, Rs 1,932 BPS 5-10, Rs 2,856 BPS 11-15, Rs 5,000 BPS 16-19 per 2015 revision); BPS 20-22 officers without official vehicle get a higher fixed rate. Verify current-year circular before payroll use.
allowances.annual_increment_note: Annual increment admissible on 1 December each year
